rocket: "#engine-status"

**Question.** Can TensorRT-LLM load NVIDIA's official `GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4` checkpoint?

| setup | |
| --- | --- |
| node | head, GB10, `sm_121` |
| TensorRT-LLM | `1.3.0rc17`, image `sha256:40bbfe426d5003eb7125a16b9ad4b30013678c5880568f253e22effc53ddadbc` |
| checkpoint | `nvidia/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4` at `423acf37583782c51c142d145aef733d72943d93` |
| Rocket commit | `0edaf75970e1cc923829786444be4737c0c3b50e` |

The checkpoint declares `model_type: glm5_next`, `architectures: [Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration]`, and `quant_algo: NVFP4`.

```bash
docker run --rm --gpus all --ipc=host --ulimit memlock=-1 --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  --entrypoint python3 -e LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/tensorrt/lib:/usr/local/cuda/lib64 \
  -v "$PWD/.cache/glm53-nvfp4-metadata:/models:ro" \
  nvcr.io/nvidia/tensorrt-llm/release:1.3.0rc17 \
  -c 'from tensorrt_llm import LLM; LLM(model="/models", tensor_parallel_size=1, max_num_tokens=128)'
```

```text
TRT-LLM version: 1.3.0rc17
LLM_INIT_ERROR= RuntimeError Executor worker returned error
ValueError: The checkpoint you are trying to load has model type `glm5_next`
but Transformers does not recognize this architecture.
```

TensorRT-LLM documents GLM-5.3 on the `GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM` path and NVFP4 with the TRTLLM MoE backend, but this exact Flash checkpoint reaches neither path because its configuration is unregistered. See the [GLM-5 deployment guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM/blob/main/docs/source/deployment-guide/deployment-guide-for-glm-5-on-trtllm.md).

**Verdict.** Rejected as a ready-made runtime for this checkpoint. NVFP4 and GB10 support are present. The `glm5_next` model adapter is absent in the tested release.

**Next.**

- Continue the Rocket loader and kernel path against the pinned checkpoint.

**Reopen if.**

- TensorRT-LLM adds `glm5_next` config and weight loading support for this checkpoint family.
